The 4th edition of Startups Without Borders summit will take place on the 10th and 11th of  February at Cairo Business Park, East Cairo’s Business, Innovation and Entrepreneurship hub.  Since 2018, Startups Without Borders has been building world-class events where diversity takes center stage, gathering over 12,000 entrepreneurs from the MENA and Europe across different cultures and nationalities.

SWB will feature all-star speakers from the tech and startup space in Europe, US, and the Middle East, including Google, Meta, and Techstars, as well as global startup competitions with up to $1 million in prizes,  international startup delegations, as well as the Investors Room, where entrepreneurs can get matched with investors for one-on-one meetings.

“For the past 5 years, we have gone from city to city in the MENA and Europe on a mission to build a transnational ecosystem for entrepreneurs, no matter where they come from. We continued to do so virtually during the pandemic, and now we couldn’t be more excited to gather in person again in Cairo, bringing startup delegations from unexpected places such as the Gaza strip and Baghdad and investors from all corners of the world, from Italy to Bangladesh. We are guided by the strong belief that talent doesn't have a passport, and the summit is our biggest and loudest testament to that." says Valentina Primo, founder and CEO of Startups Without Borders.

After 2 years running hybrid editions which connected Cairo to Amsterdam, Rome and San Francisco, the summit is back to Cairo for a feature in-person format, including 88 talks, panels and workshops with 170 powerhouse speakers, and their feature Investors Room, in partnership with high-profile VC and Investment networks including Middle East Venture Partners (MEVP). Arzan VC, Plus VC, Acasia Ventures, Raya Holding, and Silicon Badia.

The event will feature high-profile speakers in the startup and corporate landscape, such as Hashim Syed, Product Lead at Google EMEA, Ahmad Sufian Bayram, Regional Manager of Techstars MENA, and Tey El-Rjula, blockchain entrepreneur and author of “The Invisible Son.”

Having worked with prominent refugee founders for 5 years, the summit is this year featuring a special participation of olympic coach Sven Spannekrebs, who was the former swimming coach of celebrated Syrian champion Yusra Mardini and the Refugee Olympic Team during the 2016 Rio Olympics. 

The lineup also includes some of the most active investors, VCs and accelerators, who will discuss and unveil the new investment landscape, as well as power-packed workshops, offering entrepreneurs the tools to scale, from building a sales funnel, to the legal aspects of fundraising.

Startups can also apply to the Investor Room, where entrepreneurs can get selected to have a 101 meeting with investors from leading Angel Investment Networks in Europe, North America, and the Middle East. Entrepreneurs will be matched with an investor according to industry, geography and ticket size, and gear up to pitch one-on-one in a private room at the summit. 

The summit is themed: "Go Borderless," and will explore borderless opportunities across 4 main tracks: Future Tech, Impact, Investment and for the first time SWB debuts the Talent Track, sponsored by The Room, ALX.

card_description.en: The 4th edition of Startups Without Borders summit took place on the 10th/11th of Feb.

title.en: Misr Italia Properties Proves Leadership at COP27

description.en:
MIP participated in COP27 & prioritized quality through partnerships that help present comprehensive projects taking its values and sustainability measures towards a greener future.

Realising its vision for a more sustainable industry, Misr Italia Properties (MIP) led a packed and successful week at the 2022 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP27), held in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt between November 06 – 18, 2022. The real-estate visionary curated an extensive programme of insightful talks and progressive panel discussions. More importantly, the diversified real estate developer was keen on translating theoretical ideas into tangible actions. The company’s leadership signed strategic partnerships and declared commitment to international pledges.  

With over 30 years of experience under their belt, MIP is focused on dedicating its extensive experience and expertise to define the future of the industry, while remaining mindful of the environment and the planet’s welfare. Motivated by its mission to create progressive real-estate projects that are inspired by the needs of their residents, MIP is focused on following an out of the box roadmap towards sustainability. The first of its kind in the Middle East and Africa, IL BOSCO New Capital’s Vertical Forest embodies the company’s endeavors to combat climate change with smart design, and powerful vision. The three 30-meter buildings, aim to blend nature and architecture through an award-winning design. Wrapped in thousands of green plants and trees on balconies and windows, the Vertical Forest aims to limit pollution.

On the other hand, MIP also introduces the concept of 15-minute cities to Egypt through IL BOSCO City. Located in New Cairo, the unique project allows residents to access everything they need from educational services to sporting facilities, lifestyle outlets, and medical services within a 15-minute travel distance by foot or bike.

Represented by Engineers Mohamed Hany El-Assal and Mohamed Khaled El Assal CEOs and Managing Directors of MIP - in partnership with Italian urban planner and architect Stefano Boeri - the company took part in multiple activities to shed light on MIP’s best practices towards a sustainable future, in line with the Sustainable Development Goals as well as Egypt’s National Climate Change Strategy 2050.

card_description.en: MIP participated in COP27 & prioritized quality through partnerships.

title.en: Padel Tennis Tournament at IL BOSCO

description.en:
IL BOSCO International Padel Tournament was held for the second year in a row under the auspices of the Ministry of Youth and Sports and ACUD, at IL BOSCO Javelin sports club in The New Capital.

Misr Italia Properties (MIP) has announced the second edition of the IL Bosco International Padel Tournament in partnership with JPadel Egypt, scheduled to take place from May 17th to May 20th at IL Bosco Javelin Sports Club in the New Administrative Capital (NAC). The tournament will be held under the auspices of the Ministry of Youth and Sports, as well as the Administrative Capital for Urban Development, and in collaboration with the Egyptian Padel Federation and the International Padel Federation. Featuring 400 players from 10 countries, including the Netherlands, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, France, Spain, Morocco, UAE, Qatar, and Egypt, the competition this year will see players with a wide range of age groups and skill levels, competing over the course of 4 days in 200 matches.
 

By continuing to host the tournament, MIP does not only work to become a channel that fosters sports in Egypt, and padel in particular, given young Egyptians’ growing interest in the sport, but also showcase what the NAC has to offer by providing the first livable project by a private-sector developer at the Capital. Covering an area of 16,000 m2, IL Bosco Javelin Sports Club is situated within the heart of IL Bosco, MIP’s flagship residential project in the NAC, with a total investment of EGP 17 billion; featuring units designed to blend with nature and overlooking the iconic Green River as well as the world’s largest central park.

This year’s edition will include university students for the first time, with participants from Canadian universities, Ryerson University, and British Coventry Universities in the New Administrative Capital, the American University in Cairo, and the German University in Cairo. Prizes for the international championship are worth €20,000, while winners of the local championship will be receiving prizes worth EGP 200,000, and the universities tournament prize will be worth EGP 50,000.

Misr Italia Properties provides free access to the public at IL Bosco Padel tournament, meanwhile, players can participate by registering on this link https://linktr.ee/jpadeleg

description.en:
Galala Challenge is the biggest cycling event in Egypt, joined by more than 400 athletes from 12 different countries. Galala Challenge series started back in December 2018 aiming to promote the cycling sport in Egypt, becoming one of the most anticipated cycling events in the country in only three years.  

We were thrilled to host the fifth edition of Galala Challenge in collaboration with IL BOSCO Javelin Sports Club, that took place on the 22nd of October, 2021. The route started from IL BOSCO - New Capital City along Sokhna road & Galala road and ended in Galala city, the celebration was held in IL BOSCO. Therefore, all participants were transported by the buses back to The New Capital to celebrate their achievements. The total distance of the ride was 140km with more than 1,000m of elevation. We invited everyone to join us for this unique exciting event. It
was a challenging one, so we made sure everyone got ready and trained well.

title.en: Il Bosco International Padel Tournament Smashes Its Way to New Capital

description.en:
Misr Italia Properties (MIP) has announced the 3rd edition of the Il Bosco International Padel Tournament, set to take place at the Il Bosco Sports Club in the New Administrative Capital (NAC). 

This year's tournament will feature 240 international and national padel players, both male and female, as well as the inaugural juniors’ tournament. The event is scheduled to host players from a diverse range of countries, including Egypt, France, England, Spain, Sweden, Argentina, the Netherlands, Italy and Qatar, alongside first time participants Portugal, Japan, Chile, Switzerland and Hungary.

Il Bosco, MIP’s flagship project in the NAC, is noted for being the first private-sector development to be fully completed and operational in the new capital. By hosting its annual Il Bosco  International Padel Tournament, MIP aims to continue elevating its status as a leading developer in the NAC. Promising high-level competition, the tournament is an opportunity for the public to support superstar athletes from around the world. Those interested in attending can register to secure their spot at Il Bosco Sports Club.

The high-stakes Il Bosco International Padel Tournament begins tomorrow, on May 22nd, and is totally free to watch - as long as you register first. To come witness all the action live, make sure you download and register through the JPadel app.
